_doc: Seed Audio job table (art-and-audio bible 9.2-9.6). One entry per generation job. Prompts are built by tools/audio/sfx_prompts.py from the fixed 9.1 wrappers. Keep clauses verbatim from the bible tables.

jobs.clause: a blade striking blackened iron plate and bronze lamellar, a sharp clang with a short ring
a heavy mace slamming into iron plate, a deep metallic crash with a dull ring
a blade hitting a body in quilted linen armour, a thick cloth slap with a muted thud, no gore, no voice
a heavy blunt blow into a big body wrapped in thick felt, a deep meaty thump, no gore, no voice
a weapon striking a tall wooden shield, a hollow woody knock
a heavy blow on wooden planks and a cart side, a splintery crack
a weapon hitting a stack of flat stone slabs, a rocky crack and a short gravel crumble
a blow into a straw-stuffed scarecrow body, a dry straw crunch and a puff of rustling straw
fast close swings of a single-edged curved blade through the air, a short airy whoosh, no impact
heavy swings of a flanged bronze mace and of a threshing flail on a chain, a low whoosh with a faint chain rattle on some takes, no impact
quick thrusts of a war-pick and a pitchfork, a short sharp air cut, no impact
a body in cloth armour falling onto grass, a soft thud with a cloth rustle
an armoured body falling onto earth with an iron and bronze clatter
a huge heavy body falling, a ground-shaking thud with a short rumble

jobs.voice: ordinary adult townsfolk, men and women
jobs.list: winded oofs, a sharp intake of breath, two short cut-off cries, a tired sigh, no words

jobs.voice: very large deep-chested humanoids with heavy jaws
jobs.list: deep huffs, a strained bellow, a throat-hum that drops away, a long exhale, no words

jobs.p: P1 (combat juice CMB-27; asked for in PT1)
jobs.clause: a very low short thump, felt more than heard
an early hand-cannon firing: a deep whump followed by a sharp crack, then a short hissing smoke tail
a small lead ball hitting: a thud into a body, a knock into wood, a ping off iron, a puff into earth
a spear-thrower whipping a javelin away: a quick wooden snap and a fast whoosh
a bronze-tipped javelin hitting: a solid thunk into wood, a thud into a body, a ping off metal, a thud into earth
a leather sling whirling twice and releasing a stone, then the stone cracking against wood
a short bronze bombard firing: a big deep boom, a heavy low thump and a rolling smoke hiss
a cannonball landing: a deep earthy thump, dirt and stones spraying, a short rumble
a big laminated recurve bow on a swivel atop a tall wooden mast: a rope creak, a deep bowstring twang, then a fast arrow whoosh
a two-wheeled throwing-arm cart: a rope creak, the wooden arm whipping forward, a heavy thump against the stop beam
a heavy clay pot smashing on the ground: a crash of shards, a dull thump, a puff of dust
a small magical bolt of whirling dust and wind: a short rising swish, then a soft gritty puff on impact
the Linden Sister's attack: a soft papery puff and a dull leafy thud
jobs.note: table note dropped from the prompt: reused pitched down for the Crowherd's attack

jobs.clause: the Firewright's attack: a small clay pellet of embers flicked from a linstock with a hiss, then a soft fiery pop on impact
the Skymirror's glint bolt: a short bright metallic zip of reflected light ending in a soft glassy tick

jobs.list: 1. a soft wooden "tuk" (move), 2. a "tsk-tak" of wood and a small iron click (attack), 3. two quick wooden "tuk-tuk" taps (patrol), 4. a quick quill flick across paper (ability)
1. a soft felt-damped "puk" (move), 2. a "tsk-tak" with a small bronze click (attack), 3. two quick felt "puk-puk" taps (patrol), 4. a quick wooden bead flicked along a cord (ability)
1. one small tally-stick tick, 2. a double tally tick, 3. a bundle of tally sticks clacking together, 4. a single higher tally tick for a rising wave
1. one small wooden bead tick, 2. a double bead tick, 3. a short string of beads rattling, 4. a single higher bead tick for a rising wave

jobs.clause: a tiny button press: a soft dry knock on oak wood with a small iron latch tick, very short
a tiny button press: a small tap on a polished bronze plate damped by thick felt, a soft thump with a short bright tick
a dull double knock on thick wooden boards, low, flat and slightly muffled
a muffled thud on a thick felt wall followed by a low bronze bowl tone choked short by a hand
a single muffled knock on a thick wooden board, dull and short
a single soft thud on a thick felt wall, dull and short
a heavy wooden cart wheel slammed upright onto the ground, its iron rim ringing, a deep defiant resonant thud
a gentle healing spell: a soft breeze of rustling leaves and drifting blossoms, a warm low bell chord swelling gently, no voices
a clay flask flying and shattering, a liquid splash, then a big soft whoomph of ignition and crackling flames
a compact gunpowder explosion with a sharp crack and debris patter
a heavy braided rope whipping out with a crack, a bronze weight hitting with a thunk, a body dragged a short way over grass
a straight sabre ringing clean and bright after a decisive cut, a shimmering high metallic ring
a blinding flash of sunlight from a polished bronze mirror: a bright shimmering chime swell and a searing high ping
a low rush of dust rolling outward along dry grass with a soft sand hiss, then a dry "fwump" as it settles; nothing whirling or rising
hailstones pattering on stone and packing together into small birds, then an ice crackle and a wind snap; cold, no bird cry
a polished bronze mirror flipped down over the eyes, rippling like water: a small metal flip, a soft shimmering swell and a distant wind
a heavy bronze cannon dropped onto a timber platform: wheels thudding, chains settling
